# Story 12.1: Spawn no lado oposto das linhas movidas

Status: done

<!-- Generated by gds-create-story (Epic 12). Supersedes "uniformly random empty cell" spawn placement from Epic 2 / story 2-6 AC2. Authoritative design: epics.md (Epic 12). NOTE: GDD/PRD still describe uniform-random spawn and were NOT updated for this change — this story OVERRIDES them (see References). -->

## Story

As a player of Tríade,
I want each post-move spawn to appear only on the opposite edge of a line (row/column) that actually changed during my swipe,
so that I can read "where the next tile lands" from my own movement direction and feel in control of the chaos.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **[AC1 — directional placement]** After an effective move, the spawned tile is placed only on the opposite edge of a line that changed:
   - `left`  → rightmost column (`c = GRID_SIZE - 1`)
   - `right` → leftmost column (`c = 0`)
   - `up`    → bottom row (`r = GRID_SIZE - 1`)
   - `down`  → top row (`r = 0`)
2. **[AC2 — only moved lines eligible]** Only lines (rows for horizontal moves, columns for vertical moves) that moved and/or merged are eligible. A line whose content did not change is never an eligible spawn line.
3. **[AC3 — uniform among candidates, 1 draw]** Among the eligible opposite-edge cells, selection is uniform via `pickIndex` and consumes **exactly 1 rng draw** for the cell pick. The effective-move draw budget stays at 3 (cell, next value, next displayRoll) — see `types.ts` draw-budget contract.
4. **[AC4 — no fallback needed]** An eligible (changed) line always vacates its opposite-edge cell during the shift, so the candidate set is guaranteed non-empty whenever `moved === true`. No fallback branch is required.
5. **[AC5 — value + preview unchanged, backward compatible]** The value placed is still `state.pendingSpawn.value` (place-not-roll, N3 invariant). `spawnTile` gains an optional `candidates?: Array<[number, number]>` param. When `candidates` is **omitted**, behavior is unchanged (all-empty pick) so non-move callers/tests stay green. When provided, the T2 branch applies — "fallback to all-empty" applies ONLY to omission, never to a provided-but-empty pool.
6. **[AC6 — move shape unchanged]** `move()` still returns `{ board, score, moved, trace, pendingSpawn }`; the spawned tile appears in `trace` with `spawned: true`. A noop still produces no spawn and 0 draws.
7. **[AC7 — tests updated]** The AC2 tripwire in `adaptive-spawn-integration.test.ts:158` is rewritten to assert directional placement (every spawned cell is on the opposite edge of a changed line; zero spawns elsewhere or in unchanged lines). A new `spawn-placement.test.ts` covers per-direction candidate sets. All existing engine tests (incl. `game.test.ts`, `pending-spawn-contract.test.ts`) remain green — audit any hardcoded spawn-cell assumption (e.g. `game.test.ts:167` passes because `down`→top row, column 0 moved → candidate `(0,0)`).

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [x] T1 — `line.ts`: `shiftLine` returns `moved: boolean` (line content changed vs input) (AC2)
  - [x] Compute `moved` by comparing original `line` values to shifted `out` values
  - [x] Extend return type `{ line, score, moved }`; keep `score`/`line` behavior identical
- [x] T2 — `spawn.ts`: `spawnTile` accepts optional `candidates` (AC3, AC4, AC5)
  - [x] If `candidates` is **omitted** (undefined): keep current all-empty behavior (backward compatible, 1 draw via `pickIndex`)
  - [x] If `candidates` is provided: filter to cells that are empty on `board`; let `pool` = the filtered list
    - [x] If `pool.length === 0`: return `{ board, cell: null, value: null }` (0 draws) — do NOT call `pickIndex` (avoids `pool[0]` undefined crash); unreachable per AC4 but required for the engine-never-throws posture
    - [x] Else: `const cell = pool[pickIndex(pool.length, rng)]` (exactly 1 draw)
  - [x] Preserve existing full-board handling: when `candidates` omitted and no empty cell exists, return `{ board, cell: null, value: null }`
- [x] T3 — `game.ts`: compute candidate cells in `move()` and pass to `spawnTile` (AC1, AC4, AC6)
  - [x] **Return-type coupling (required by T1):** T1 changes `shiftLine` to return `{ line, score, moved }`. In `move()`:
    - [x] Store the full result: `const res = shiftLine(lines[i]); shifted.push(res); score += res.score;`
    - [x] Before `boardFromLines`, unwrap: `const built = boardFromLines(shifted.map(s => s.line), dir);` — `boardFromLines` expects `ShiftedCell[][]`, NOT the new wrapper object
  - [x] Derive `oppCol`/`oppRow` from `dir` (see AC1 mapping)
  - [x] Iterate `shifted[i].moved`; push opposite-edge cell of each moved line (`oppCol` → `(i, oppCol)` for horizontal; `oppRow` → `(oppRow, i)` for vertical)
  - [x] Call `spawnTile(newBoard, state.pendingSpawn.value, rng, candidates)`; keep trace/spawn/score logic unchanged
- [x] T4 — Tests (AC7)
  - [x] Rewrite `adaptive-spawn-integration.test.ts:158` tripwire → assert directional placement across seeded moves (opposite edge of changed lines only; 0 spawns off-edge or in unchanged lines)
  - [x] Add `triade/__tests__/engine/spawn-placement.test.ts`: per-direction candidate assertions (left→rightmost col of moved rows; up→bottom row of moved cols; unchanged line excluded; 1 draw)
  - [x] Audit `game.test.ts` (esp. `:167`), `pending-spawn-contract.test.ts` (3-draw & 1-draw assertions) — confirm still green; relax any position assumption that assumed board-wide randomness
- [x] T5 — Doc comment (optional): update `spawnTile` note in `types.ts` draw-budget block to mention the candidate path; draw count unchanged (1)

- **Source of truth:** the pure TS engine in `triade/src/engine/core/` is the single source of truth; UI never duplicates spawn/merge/score rules (architecture `_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architectures/architecture-3-clone-2026-08-07/game-architecture.md:74`, `:185`). This change touches only engine internals — no UI/runtime change beyond *where* the tile appears.
- **Files to touch (all UPDATE, none NEW beyond the test):**
  - `triade/src/engine/core/line.ts` (`shiftLine`)
  - `triade/src/engine/core/spawn.ts` (`spawnTile`)
  - `triade/src/engine/core/game.ts` (`move`)
  - `triade/__tests__/engine/adaptive-spawn-integration.test.ts` (rewrite tripwire)
  - `triade/__tests__/engine/spawn-placement.test.ts` (NEW)
- **Preserve:** draw-budget contract (`types.ts:7-17`) — `move` effective = 3 draws, `spawnTile` cell pick = 1 draw; ADR-06 immutable `GameState` snapshot (board + pendingSpawn); N3 Ambiguous Preview (Epic 7) reads only `value`/`displayRoll`, never position — unaffected.
- **Architecture compliance:** engine cost per turn budget `< 2 ms` (`_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architectures/architecture-3-clone-2026-08-07/game-architecture.md:193`); this adds only a tiny candidate-cell loop, well within budget. No new dependency. Expo SDK 57 / RN 0.86 stack unchanged — when in doubt consult `https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/`.
- **Why AC4 holds (no fallback needed):** in a contiguous 2048-style shift, if a line's content changed (`moved === true`), some tile shifted left/up, which cascades and nulls the far (opposite) slot of that line — so its opposite-edge cell is always vacated. Hence the candidate set is non-empty and every candidate is empty whenever `moved === true`. Do NOT add a fallback branch.
- **Previous-story intelligence:** Story 2-6 built the combined single-roll resolver and the snapshot/pendingSpawn shape this story reuses — do NOT alter `resolveSpawn`, `pickIndex`, or the pendingSpawn contract (only the *cell* selection changes). Story 1-2 is the engine port this sits on.

### Implementation Plan

- **T1 (`line.ts`)**: `shiftLine` now returns `{ line, score, moved }`. `moved` is derived by comparing each output cell value to the original `CellRef.v` (`out.some((c, i) => c.v !== line[i].v)`). Score/line behavior unchanged.
- **T2 (`spawn.ts`)**: `spawnTile` gained an optional 4th `candidates?: Array<[number,number]>` arg. When omitted, behavior is identical to before (all-empty pick, 1 draw). When provided, the pool is `candidates` filtered to cells empty on `board`; if the pool is empty it returns `{cell:null,value:null}` with 0 draws (engine-never-throws); otherwise it picks uniformly with exactly 1 `pickIndex` draw.
- **T3 (`game.ts`)**: `move()` stores the full `shiftLine` result, unwraps `.line` for `boardFromLines`, and builds the `candidates` array from `shifted[i].moved` — opposite edge of each moved line (`left→col GRID_SIZE-1`, `right→col 0`, `up→row GRID_SIZE-1`, `down→row 0`). Passes `candidates` to `spawnTile`. Trace/score/pendingSpawn logic untouched; the move still returns `{board,score,moved,trace,pendingSpawn}` and the 3-draw budget is preserved (cell pick + next value + displayRoll).

### Debug Log References

- Two acceptance scaffolds were internally inconsistent with the story's filter-to-empty contract (T2/AC5): `spawn-placement.test.ts` AC3 used a board that contradicted its own "candidates are a subset of empties" comment, and `game.test.ts` / `transitionPlan.test.ts` pinned spawn cells to the old board-wide-random positions. Both were relaxed to the new directional placements so all 347 engine+render tests pass. The directional contract and draw-budget assertions are intact.
